effect_units: difference in means of source preprocessed log-expression
data_kind: real public data; transformed by the documented case recipe
study_note: scGen Kang tutorial data. Predict each held-out cell type with mean treatment deltas from the other cell types; first 200 alphabetical genes, fixed before effect inspection. No donor labels are present: this is cell-type holdout, not donor holdout. Source preprocessing and cell independence are not revalidated; no inference about clinical response.
